context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

I turned trace export on by passing ENABLE_TRACE_EXPORT=true on the command line when I started the service, and set the app name as a constant in code. The report says environments are switched on. Is that right?

checklist.name: switches-and-identity-in-config-file
checklist.description: Answers no: the export switch, the content switch and the application identity must be set in a config file the app actually loads (the environment's own env file, or the personal gitignored .env for a temporary value) and cited as file:line.

checklist.name: default-off-in-code-on-per-environment
checklist.description: States that kill switches default OFF in code and are turned ON per environment in that environment's config.

checklist.name: no-inline-or-constant-as-wiring
checklist.description: Does not treat an inline command-line value or a code constant as wiring. FAIL if it reports the environment as switched on.
